history.created_by: RUN /bin/sh -c apk upgrade --no-cache     && apk add --no-cache --virtual .scan-deps pax-utils     && runDeps="$(scanelf --needed --nobanner --format '%n#p' --recursive /usr/local | tr ',' '\n' | sort -u | awk 'system("[ -e /usr/local/lib/" $1 " ]") == 0 { next } { print "so:" $1 }')"     && apk add --no-cache --virtual .postgresql-rundeps ${runDeps} bash tzdata zstd icu-data-full ca-certificates     && apk del --no-network .scan-deps     && addgroup -g 70 -S postgres     && adduser -u 70 -S -D -G postgres -H -h /var/lib/postgresql -s /bin/sh postgres     && mkdir -p /var/lib/postgresql /var/run/postgresql /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d     && chown postgres:postgres /var/lib/postgresql /var/run/postgresql     && chmod 1777 /var/lib/postgresql && chmod 3777 /var/run/postgresql     && sed -i "s/^#listen_addresses = 'localhost'/listen_addresses = '*'/" /usr/local/share/postgresql/postgresql.conf.sample     && test "$(postgres --version)" = "postgres (PostgreSQL) 18.6"     && ! apk info --installed libxml2     && ! ldd /usr/local/bin/postgres | grep -E 'libxml|libxslt' # buildkit
